about_short_description.short_description: Reverie Labs is a machine learning-driven pharma company.

product.name: Supervised Machine Learning (ML)
product.description: Develops deep-learning architectures to predict molecular properties such as on-target binding, toxicity, and ADMET for lead discovery and optimization.

product.name: Virtual Screening
product.description: Enumerates and screens millions of compounds in virtual libraries for hit identification, combining medicinal chemistry expertise with machine learning models.

product.name: Computational Chemistry & Modeling
product.description: Uses simulation techniques and statistical ML to understand the energetics of bound ligands to protein targets and design kinase inhibitors.

product.name: Algorithmic Molecular Generation
product.description: Generates selective, synthesizable, stable, and tissue-penetrant molecules using computational techniques like genetic algorithms and continuous latent models.

product.name: Pipeline
product.description: Comprises wholly-owned drug candidates and those developed with partners, focusing on addressing limitations of current therapies and novel targets.

product.name: Representation and Visualization
product.description: Builds rich data representations using diverse featurizations for small molecules and proteins, from SMILES methods to custom QM-based representations.
